# models

Small XML models for the compiler tests.

## Files

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `fixture_four_wheel.xml` | `fixture-murphy-2024-full` model, type `vehicle-assembly`, subtype `four-wheel`. |
| `fixture_four_wheel_extended.xml` | `fixture-murphy-2024-extended` model, type `vehicle-assembly`, subtype `four-wheel`. |
| `fixture_four_wheel_reduced.xml` | `fixture-murphy-2024-reduced` model, type `vehicle-assembly`, subtype `four-wheel`. |
| `fixture_point_mass.xml` | `fixture-murphy-point-mass` model, type `vehicle-formulation`, subtype `point-mass`. |
| `fixture_point_mass_extended.xml` | `fixture-murphy-point-mass-extended` model, type `vehicle-formulation`, subtype `point-mass`. |
| `fixture_point_mass_reduced.xml` | `fixture-murphy-point-mass-reduced` model, type `vehicle-formulation`, subtype `point-mass`. |
| `suspension_lookup_2024.xml` | `fixture-suspension-lookup-2024` model, type `suspension-model`, subtype `lookup-table`. |
| `transient_comp_2024.xml` | `fixture-transient-comp-2024` model, type `tire-model`, subtype `transient-combined-slip`. |
| `transient_comp_2025.xml` | `fixture-transient-comp-2025` model, type `tire-model`, subtype `transient-combined-slip`. |
